name: MCAIPC2
tagline: Three mainboard series with configurable memory, networking, and chassis
description: MCAIPC2 is a configurable AI computer family spanning AXB35-02, AXB35-03, and AEB35-04 mainboards. Choose series-specific AMD processor platforms, LPDDR5 memory, 2.5GbE or dual 10GbE networking, and expansion through USB4, optional Flex I/O, or MCIO. Compatible desktop and tower enclosures offer internal or external power options; the configuration guide below shows which combinations are supported.

specifications.label: Mainboard series
specifications.value: AXB35-02: AMD FP11 Strix Halo, Ryzen AI Max 300; AXB35-03: AMD FP11 Strix/Gorgon Halo, Ryzen AI Max 300/400; AEB35-04: AMD FP10 Medusa Point (Zen 6)

specifications.label: GPU / NPU
specifications.value: AXB35-02: AMD integrated graphics; AXB35-03: Radeon 8000S series; AEB35-04: next-generation RDNA GPU, up to 50 TOPS, and XDNA 3 NPU, up to 100 TOPS

specifications.label: Memory
specifications.value: AXB35-02/-03: LPDDR5 8000 MT/s, up to 128 GB; AEB35-04: LPDDR5 9600 MT/s, 64 GB or 96 GB

specifications.label: Storage
specifications.value: AXB35-02: 2 x M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 x4; AXB35-03: 2 x M.2 2280 plus optional M.2 2242/2280 for Flex I/O; AEB35-04: 2 x M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 x4; SD 4.0 supported

specifications.label: Network
specifications.value: AXB35-02: 1 x RJ45 2.5 GbE; AXB35-03 and AEB35-04: 2 x RJ45 10 GbE

specifications.label: USB
specifications.value: Front, all series: 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A and 1 x USB4; rear: AXB35-02 has 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 2, 2 x USB 2.0 and 1 x USB4; AXB35-03/AEB35-04 have 1 x USB 3.2, 1 x USB 2.0 and 1 x USB4

specifications.label: Audio
specifications.value: AXB35-02/-03: front and rear combo jacks; AEB35-04: 1 x combo jack

specifications.label: Display
specifications.value: AXB35-02/-03: HDMI 2.1, DP 1.4 and 2 x USB4; AEB35-04: HDMI 2.1, DP 2.0 and 2 x USB4

specifications.label: Expansion
specifications.value: AXB35-03: optional M.2 Flex I/O for OCuLink or dual 80 Gbps USB4 data; AEB35-04: 1 x MCIO, PCIe 4.0 x8

specifications.label: Wi-Fi / Bluetooth
specifications.value: M.2 2230 PCIe/USB module; AXB35-02 supports 2.4/5 GHz; AXB35-03/AEB35-04 support 2.4/5/6 GHz; Bluetooth 5.0 or later

specifications.label: PSU / input
specifications.value: H01/H02/H03/H06/H07: internal 300/350 W Flex PSU; other documented chassis: 20 V / 12 A, 240 W external adapter

specifications.label: OS
specifications.value: AXB35-02/-03: Windows 11; AEB35-04: Windows 11 or Linux

specifications.label: Dimensions
specifications.value: Chassis-dependent; see the chassis compatibility guide below for dimensions and power options.

features.title: Three Mainboard Series
features.description: Choose AXB35-02, AXB35-03, or AEB35-04. Processor, graphics, NPU, memory, and operating-system support depend on the selected series.

features.title: Series-Specific Connectivity
features.description: AXB35-02 provides one 2.5GbE RJ45 port. AXB35-03 and AEB35-04 provide two 10GbE RJ45 ports, with different optional high-speed expansion interfaces.

features.title: Chassis and Power Options
features.description: Match the selected mainboard to a compatible chassis, with an internal 300/350 W Flex PSU or a 240 W external adapter. Fingerprint, lighting, and cooling options vary by enclosure.
